title: GET /checkpoints – query
description: Query string parameters, each at most once (as strings in the URL; the schema describes them decoded). Absent parameter: no filter. A malformed value is 422 validation_failed.

site_id.description: Only the checkpoints of this site; a site the caller does not see gives an empty list.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page; absent: the first page.
